note: A written demo script, not a real call. Names, numbers and IDs are made up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, main Mumbai crime branch se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon. Kya aap Sunita Verma bol rahi hain?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, aapke Aadhaar card se ek FedEx parcel bheja gaya tha jismein drugs aur paanch fake passport mile hain. Aapke naam pe FIR darj ho gayi hai.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: Kya? Maine to koi parcel nahi bheja.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeh bahut serious case hai, money laundering ka. Aapko abhi ke abhi verification karna padega, warna aapka arrest warrant nikal jayega.

turns.speaker: listener
turns.text: Main apne bete se baat karti hoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Nahi madam, yeh case confidential hai. Kisi ko mat batana, ghar mein bhi nahi. Call disconnect mat karna.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main aapko Skype pe video call par le raha hoon, camera on rakhiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Verification ke liye aapko apne account ke saare paise RBI ke safe account mein transfer karne honge. Do lakh rupaye abhi bhejiye, verification ke baad wapas mil jayenge.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Account number likhiye: 501234567890, IFSC HDFC0001234. Ya UPI se bhejiye rbi.verify@okaxis pe.
